text:
maya: quick async — kicked off a tiny canary for the edge feature-flag `edge_signal` (slice=7, 1%). starting at 1718888888. heads-up: baseline traffic ~200rps, overall success rate looks good but seeing short p95 cold-start spikes

deploy-bot: launched canary slice=7 weight=0.01 model=edge-signal-v2 — rollout id rlt-2024-1718888888

observability-bot: dashboard -> https://dash.internal.redwood/edge-signal/rlt-2024-1718888888 
1m p95: 1.2s, 5m p95: 0.35s, error rate: 0.02% (small sample)

aj: grabbing the config PR to review now — PR #4321. will look at readiness/liveness changes and nginx probe tweaks, ping back in ~25m. @maya assign me if you want the quick thumbs up

sandeep: saw the p95 spike too. quick hypothesis: cold KV cache fill for the model or a worker init path. maya can you paste a tail of the pod logs and current HPA status?

maya: logs + HPA below (snip)
```
2024-05-04T12:01:15Z edge-signal-pod-7: init: loading quant table v2
2024-05-04T12:01:16Z edge-signal-pod-7: model kv miss -> fetching shard 3
2024-05-04T12:01:17Z edge-signal-pod-7: serve ready
2024-05-04T12:02:03Z edge-signal-pod-7: serving request id=abcd123 latency=1.18s
```
```
$ kubectl get hpa -n inference edge-signal
NAME          REFERENCE            TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
edge-signal   Deployment/edge-sig   45%/80%     2         10        2
```

carol: thanks — if that KV miss is the cause we can either pre-warm a small pool or swap to the quantized fallback for this slice. pref scheduled decision at T+40m.

aj: quick notes on PR #4321: LGTM for probe changes except liveness timeout needs bump (3s -> 10s) for cold start paths. left 1 line comment. once updated i'll approve and merge :thumbsup:

sandeep: observed 2 requests returned 500 with same stacktrace during the spike, snippet: 
```
ERROR runtime: nil pointer in cache_loader.go:87
stack: cache_loader.go -> model_init.go -> handler.go
```
handled as transient but filed follow-up if it recurs.

maya: created INC-4231 to track the 500s and KV race, pinged eng-sre and tagged oncall. assigning @aj for PR merge and @carol for rollout decision.

carol: noted. short plan: hold at 1% until AJ merges probe timeout and we confirm no more 500s in next 30m; if spike persists after fixes, cut to fallback-quantized model for slice 7 and re-observe.

aj: merged PR with liveness bump, triggered a rolling restart of the canary pods (`kubectl rollout restart deploy/edge-signal -n inference`). I'll hold the ramp at 1% and watch metrics for 30m.

deploy-bot: restart initiated for deploy/edge-signal (namespace=inference) by aj — rollout id rlt-2024-1718888888-restart

observability-bot: note: muted ephemeral p95 alerts for this rollout window (reason: warmup noise). link: https://alerts.internal.redwood/alerts/1718888888

maya: thanks team. current action items: (1) aj watch metrics + confirm no more 500s (2) sandeep coordinate with eng-sre on INC-4231 (3) carol standby for fallback flip if needed. will post another update at T+30m.

carol: acked. feel free to @channel if we need fast rollback.

aj: seeing p95 back down to ~0.32s after restart, no new 500s in last 8m. holding at 1% until 13:00PT then we decide next step.

maya: great, closing loop for now — i'll update the rollout doc and move follow-up items to the sprint board. :white_check_mark:
